connector.name: Styx MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for Styx - intelligent AI routing across OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and Mistral.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package styx-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the timmx7 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: STYX_API_KEY
env.description: Styx API key for routing AI requests through the gateway (required for styx_send_request)

env.name: STYX_TOKEN
env.description: Styx auth token for project and key management (required for management tools)

env.name: STYX_PROXY_URL
env.description: Styx proxy URL for AI request routing
